title: Stowaway experiment clipboard - mini sheet
content:
STOWAWAY EXP CLIPBOARD — compact run sheet (personal)

Quick purpose: lightweight tracker for small inference tweaks I want to remember / re-run. Not a canonical bench — biased to my dev setup (g4dn-like). Use as single-file scratch before formalizing in bench repo.

Column header: Run | Date | Model | Quant | Batch | Seq | KV cache | Throughput (tok/s) | Latency P50 / P95 (ms) | Cost / 1k tok (est) | Quality notes | Flags / Next

R1 | 2025-11-07 | llama-7b-v1 | 8-bit (q8_0) | 1 | 512 | cold | 980 | 58 / 170 | $0.018 | short responses slightly truncated on multi-turn, ok for prompts <=200 | re-run w/ cache warm
R2 | 2025-11-09 | llama-7b-v1 | 4-bit (q4_0) | 1 | 512 | warm | 1450 | 42 / 120 | $0.012 | answers more complete, occasional repetition | baseline for q4 perf
R3 | 2025-11-12 | hf/pythia-2.8b | fp16 | 2 | 256 | warm | 860 | 76 / 230 | $0.025 | surprisingly peppy multi-turn but token quality lower on code prompts | compare P95 on longer sequences
R4 | 2025-12-01 | custom-compat-v1 | q4_0 + KV compress | 4 | 128 | warm | 2600 | 31 / 90 | $0.009 | batching helps throughput, some semantics lost on long prompts | TODO: test with reranker
R5 | 2026-01-11 | llama-13b-v2 | q8_1 mixed | 1 | 1024 | cold | 620 | 110 / 340 | $0.045 | high latency for long seq, but quality best so far | try prefix-kv caching
R6 | 2026-01-18 | llama-13b-v2 | q4_0 | 1 | 1024 | warm | 980 | 80 / 260 | $0.028 | large drop in p95 after warm cache, acceptable trade| mark for dedicated run
R7 | 2026-02-04 | redwood-tiny-re-rank | fp16 | 8 | 64 | n/a (stateless) | 3400 | 18 / 48 | $0.003 | cheap reranker, good for pipeline A | integrate into A/B test
R8 | 2026-02-17 | llama-7b-v1 | q4_0 + mem-cache | 2 | 256 | warm (session warmed) | 1720 | 36 / 98 | $0.011 | mem-cache reduced repeated prompt cost a lot; P95 still spikes under interleaving | investigate prefetch policy

NOTES TO SELF:
- Cost estimates are back-of-envelope based on current per-GPU token cost (internal price sheet), not billing. Recompute before sharing.
- "Warm" = KV cache primed with preceding conversation (approx 5 preceding requests). "Cold" = first request after model spin-up.
- Throughput measured via small local harness (script: bench/run_quick.sh). Add guard rails before using these as canonical numbers.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO:
- Q: Are we seeing quantization artifacts at ~>1k seq for q4_0? I saw truncation on some long code outputs (R2 vs R6). ACTION: schedule 2 longer seq runs (2k tokens) on q4_0 and q8_1 and capture logits where possible.
- TODO: add a short column for "spin-up time" (currently eyeballed) — I think cold-first-token P50 is a big UX component.
- TODO: reconcile with bench results in runtime repo: make small PR to add warm/cold labels to existing bench harness.

QUICK CHECKLIST BEFORE formal bench:
- [ ] Standardize prompt set (pick 6: chat short, chat long, code gen, summarization, Q&A, rerank)
- [ ] Add deterministic seeding where possible
- [ ] Run each config 3x to get stable P95
- [ ] Record GPU mem footprint (script: tools/gpu_snapshot.py)

SHORTHAND LINES (recent run insights):
- 2026-02-17: mem-cache + q4_0 = best cost/latency balance for sessioned chat (subjective quality OK).
- 2026-01-11: 13b q8_1 still best quality but expensive; consider dedicated for heavy customers.
- Re-ranker cheap: can offload to CPU for some flows (check R7).

REFERENCES / LINKS:
- bench harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench/tree/main/quick
- internal perf discussion thread: slack://channel/engineering-infer/thread/16784592
- linear ticket for follow-ups: LINEAR-1209

END — small, messy, meant for re-run and transposition to proper bench repo when I have time. Keep around as single-file memory of small experiments.
